'''Street Fighter League Pro-US 2024''' ('''SFL Pro-US 2024''') was the 7th season of professional American ''Street Fighter'' team competition.

==Information==
===Format===
*'''Game Format''' 
**The league is made of 6 teams of 4 players, where 3 of the 4 players are selected each week to participate in team battles
**In each battle one team is the home team and the other the away team
***The away team must declare the player order and character selection before the battle begins
***The home team is able to choose the players and character selection as the battle progresses
**Battles consist of consecutive matches with each being scored with the following format:

{| class="wikitable" style="width:400px;text-align:center;font-size:88%;margin-left:45px"
! Matches 
! Games
! Points
|-
| 1st Match || First to 2 || +10 PTS
|-
| 2nd Match || First to 2 || +10 PTS
|-
| 3rd Match || First to 3 || +20 PTS
|-
| Tie Breaker || First to 1 || +5 PTS
|}

*'''Regular Season'''
** Double round-robin
** Top 4 teams advance to the Playoffs

*'''Playoffs'''
** Quarterfinals and Semifinals are First to 50 points
** Grand Finals is First to 70 points
** Winner qualifies to the [[Street_Fighter_League/World_Championship/2024|Street Fighter League World Championship 2024]]
